info.title: Vextorium
info.description: Pay-per-call data APIs for AI agents, paid in USDC via x402 on Base or Solana. Failed requests are not charged. No API key or account: access is granted per request by the x402 payment.

post.summary: Summarize or analyze a text with local AI
post.description: AI text summarization and analysis (Qwen2.5-7B, local). Send any text in the 'texto' field (you may start it with an instruction, e.g. 'Summarize in 3 bullets: ...') and get a concise summary or analysis in the same language.

texto.description: Text to summarize or analyze; it may begin with an instruction (e.g. 'Summarize in 3 bullets: ...')

example.texto: Texto de ejemplo a resumir o analizar

402.description: Payment required (x402 v2, USDC on Base or Solana)

post.summary: Convert messy CSV data into clean JSON
post.description: CSV cleaning and normalization to JSON: column names, types, duplicates and empty values. Data is processed in memory and not stored.

input.description: Contenido crudo del CSV a limpiar

datos.description: Cleaned rows; each row is an object whose keys are the (normalized) CSV column names

example.aviso_privacidad: Estos datos se procesan en memoria y no se almacenan.

402.description: Payment required (x402 v2, USDC on Base or Solana)

post.summary: Analyze an EVM, Bitcoin or Solana wallet
post.description: Wallet analysis read directly from the blockchain on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon (account type incl. smart wallet / EIP-7702, sent transaction count, ENS name, native and USDC/stablecoin balances with USD value); also Bitcoin and Solana balances.

direccion.description: Direccion de la wallet (0x... para EVM, o formato nativo de Bitcoin/Solana)

contrato.description: Token contract (null for the native coin)
